rule_summary: Every reimbursable expense must have a clear documented business purpose
required_evidence: Trip purpose + employee context on submission

rule_summary: Expenses must be reasonable necessary and incurred at the lowest practical cost
exceptions: Documented business need for higher-cost option
non_reimbursable_conditions: Expenses that exceed lowest reasonable cost without justification

rule_summary: All expenses must be supported by original itemized receipts (per TEP-007)
exceptions: (TEP-007 carves $25 waiver — but TEP-007 is NOT in corpus)

rule_summary: Expense reports must be submitted within 30 days of trip end
Approval thresholds by amount
non_reimbursable_conditions: Submission exceeding amount without correct-grade approval

rule_summary: Approval thresholds are cumulative per submission
Exceptions require CFO written approval before incurring
non_reimbursable_conditions: Retroactive exception requests in non-emergency cases

rule_summary: Economy is the default for domestic and short-haul international flights
non_reimbursable_conditions: Higher class on domestic flight without §2.2/2.3 trigger

rule_summary: Premium economy permitted on single segments ≥6h
exceptions: None — no extra approval needed if duration met
non_reimbursable_conditions: Premium economy on segment <6h without approval

rule_summary: Business class permitted only on international segments ≥10h with prior VP approval
non_reimbursable_conditions: Business class on segment <10h OR without VP approval OR domestic

rule_summary: First class is not reimbursable under any circumstances
Flights should be booked through Concur Travel whenever practical
Bookings ≥14 days ahead; <7 days requires manager approval
exact_threshold: 14 days lead time; <7 needs manager approval
exceptions: Documented urgent business need with manager approval
non_reimbursable_conditions: Last-minute booking with no manager approval

rule_summary: Lowest reasonable fare — direct flights preferred if price diff <$200
First checked bag reimbursable; second requires manager approval
Extra-legroom seats reimbursable on flights ≥4h or documented accommodation
Change/cancellation fees reimbursable when for documented business reason
In-flight Wi-Fi reimbursable if used for business
Employees may not select higher-cost flights solely to accumulate miles
Companion travel costs are never reimbursable
Personal extension reimburses only what business-only fare would have cost
Employee grade ladder defines approval authority
VP approval = Grade 9 or above
Grade does not change per-diem or lodging tier caps
exact_threshold: Caps are uniform regardless of grade
non_reimbursable_conditions: Claiming higher cap based on grade

rule_summary: Acting capacity must be formally designated in writing
exact_threshold: Written designation by absent manager's manager

rule_summary: All international travel requires advance VP (Grade 9+) written approval
Approval requests should be submitted ≥14 days before departure
Travel to OFAC-sanctioned countries is prohibited absent OFAC license
non_reimbursable_conditions: Any travel to sanctioned destination without license

rule_summary: International destinations not in tier 1–3 fall under Tier 4 with cap set at approval; reference State Dept M&IE
International per-diem may be elected for trips ≥3 nights
Business class on international segments ≥10h with VP approval; premium economy default ≥6h
Personal stopovers at employee expense with comparison quote
Foreign-currency expenses reported in USD at transaction-date rate; FX fees reimbursable as separate line
exact_threshold: Corporate Card rate or OANDA daily
required_evidence: Card-statement FX rate or OANDA reference
non_reimbursable_conditions: FX fees bundled into underlying expense

rule_summary: Cash advances require advance Finance approval and limited amounts
Visa fees / courier / required immunizations reimbursable at actual cost
Passport fees not reimbursable unless required solely for a specific business trip (VP approval)
exceptions: Rare case where passport solely for the trip
non_reimbursable_conditions: Passport fee without applicable VP approval

rule_summary: Alcohol policy applies internationally with stricter local-law overlay (TEP-003 §6)
non_reimbursable_conditions: Alcohol where local law restricts it (regardless of TEP-003)

rule_summary: Dependent/companion costs on international trips never reimbursable
